newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Air starts direct flights to Sarajevo.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Air starts direct flights to Sarajevo.

text.p: Austrian Airlines said on Monday it had resumed commercial flights to Sarajevo after a four-year break, becoming the first Western European airline to offer a direct service to the Bosnian capital.
A spokeswoman for the company said the first Austrian Airlines flight to Sarajevo had left Vienna early Monday afternoon. The service would operate on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday.
"Austrian Airlines is the first airline to fly direct to Sarajevo. Others fly via Zagreb," the spokeswoman said.
Sarajevo's battle-scarred airport reopened to commercial traffic in August, 1996.
